We recognize and respect the history, languages, and cultures of the First Nations, Metis, Inuit and all Indigenous peoples whose presence continues to enrich our communities.

7.
Delegations, Petitions and Presentations
7.1
Cory Holmes - Stoco
Local resident, Cory Holmes, will attend the Council meeting as a delegation to present information and a request to forming a “new stoco hamlet committee”.
Mr. Holmes will also request Council’s permission to use a space outside of the closed arena building on the parks and recreation land area to put a small to medium sized outdoor rink this winter (similar to what Marlbank recreation arena is already doing) to be organized by volunteers and not the Municipality Parks & Recreation department.
Mr. Holmes will further outline a request for a new “stoco area recreation arena" task force be created. Where volunteers, community partners like the Lions Club, Kiwanis or small businesses can get involved with information sharing, community input and begin fundraising efforts to help with the municipality costs for repairs/changes to be made to the building.
